name: Lucatiel of Mirrah

steps.action: Speak to her by the bonfire in original DS2, or in the first upper building in Scholar. Exhaust her dialogue.
Talk to her in the tower near McDuff.
Talk to her near the lower bonfire.
Find her on a hidden ledge and talk.
Talk to her at the first bonfire (Final step).

notes: Lucatiel must survive three victories against Flexile Sentry, Lost Sinner, Smelter Demon or the Rotten before the final Aldia’s Keep conversation. Repeated victories using Ascetics count. Her meeting spots differ by edition.

name: Benhart of Jugo

steps.action: Talk to him near the entrance to Shaded Woods.
Talk to him after unpetrifying Rosabeth.
Talk to him at the Central Castle bonfire.
Talk to him after the boss fight (Final step).

reward: Bluemoon Greatsword; Benhart’s Set; Benhart’s Parma
notes: Benhart must survive three qualifying boss victories before the final conversation in Memory of Orro. Prowling Magus and Congregation, Looking Glass Knight and Giant Lord count; repeated victories using Ascetics count. Elana does not count.

name: Mild-Mannered Pate

steps.action: Talk to him, go through the gate trap, and talk again.
Talk to him near the central bonfire.
Witness the showdown between him and Creighton.

notes: Decide who to help in the final encounter.

name: Creighton the Wanderer

steps.action: Talk to him in the jail cell near Undead Lockaway.
Talk to him at the fork in the road.
Final showdown with Pate.

notes: Warning: Pate might be the one telling the truth... or maybe neither is.

name: Stone Trader Chloanne

steps.action: Talk to her at the beginning of the area.
Talk to her after she moves to Majula.

notes: She is the daughter of Blacksmith Lenigrast.

name: Royal Sorcerer Navlaan

steps.action: Stay hollow and leave the barrier lever untouched. Speak to Navlaan to begin his requests.
Show a Ladder Miniature bought from Gilligan to receive a Dispelling Ring.
Show Cale’s Helm, earned by completing Cale’s map objectives, to receive Simpleton’s Spice.
Show the Sunset Staff: Felkin gives one at 20 base INT and 20 base FTH; another is found outside Aldia’s Keep. Receive Forbidden Sun.
Show the Aged Feather given by the Emerald Herald in Dragon Aerie. Receive Unleash Magic, then talk again for the Chaos Set.

reward: Dispelling Ring; Simpleton’s Spice; Forbidden Sun; Unleash Magic; Chaos Set
notes: All four proof items can be obtained without killing the requested NPCs. Releasing Navlaan ends the quest and Bonfire Ascetics do not reset the lever.

name: Rosabeth of Melfia

steps.action: Use a Fragrant Branch of Yore on the petrified woman blocking the gatehouse switch.
Give her at least one piece of wearable clothing and exhaust her dialogue.
Meet her in Majula to buy pyromancies and reinforce Pyromancy Flames with Fire Seeds.

notes: Clothing given to Rosabeth is not returned.

name: Weaponsmith Ornifex

steps.action: Obtain the Fang Key from the petrified Lion Warrior near the Shaded Ruins bonfire.
Unlock Ornifex’s cell in the underground cave and exhaust her dialogue.
Meet her in her workshop in Lower Brightstone Cove to exchange boss souls for equipment.

reward: Boss soul trades; the first weapon trade has its soul fee waived
notes: The boss soul itself is still required for the first trade. Keep nearby enemies away from her.

name: Darkdiver Grandahl

steps.location: Shaded Woods; Black Gulch; Drangleic Castle
steps.action: Find Grandahl at all three locations and accept membership in the Pilgrims of Dark.

steps.location: Shaded Woods; Black Gulch; Drangleic Castle
steps.action: Explore each of the three Dark Chasm of Old branches, light its brazier and defeat its enemies before leaving.

steps.location: Shaded Woods; Black Gulch; Drangleic Castle
steps.action: Complete the covenant trials and defeat Darklurker, then speak to Grandahl for the final rewards.

reward: Covenant ranks; Dragon Chime; Xanthous Set
notes: Re-entry normally costs a Human Effigy. Bring a flame source to light the braziers.

name: Head of Vengarl

steps.action: Find the disembodied head in the foggy woods and listen to his full story for Vengarl’s Helm.
Defeat his hostile body: after Freja in original DS2, or behind a petrified Lion Warrior in Shaded Woods in Scholar.
Return to the head to unlock additional weapon stock and his summon availability.

reward: Vengarl’s Helm; body armor drops; expanded stock and summons
notes: Head and body are different encounters. Killing the friendly head is not required.

name: Alsanna, Silent Oracle

steps.action: Defeat Aava and speak to Alsanna so the blizzard ends and frozen routes reopen.
Recruit the three scattered Loyce Knights, then defeat the Burnt Ivory King with their help.
Collect 5 Loyce Souls for gauntlets and leggings, 15 for the armor, and 35 for the helm.
At 50 Loyce Souls, the stairs clear completely. Speak to her for her soul; Maughlin can then sell the Ivory King Set.

reward: Loyce Set; Soul of Alsanna; Ivory King Set purchase unlocked
notes: Keep the Loyce Souls for her progression; killing Alsanna is not equivalent to completing her collection rewards.

name: Cale the Cartographer

steps.action: Exhaust Cale’s dialogue in the cave for the House Key. Defeat the Last Giant and clear the mansion basement so he can move in.
Defeat the Last Giant, Lost Sinner, Old Iron King, the Rotten and the Duke’s Dear Freja.
Obtain the King’s Ring and Ashen Mist Heart, then defeat Throne Watcher and Throne Defender.
Return to Cale after all eight map flames are lit to receive his equipment.

notes: Cale’s Helm also serves as proof for Navlaan’s second request.

name: Manscorpion Tark

steps.action: Wear the Ring of Whispers to understand Tark and exhaust his dialogue.
Defeat Scorpioness Najka and return to him for a Fragrant Branch of Yore.
Return after defeating the Duke’s Dear Freja for the Second Dragon Ring.

reward: Fragrant Branch of Yore; Second Dragon Ring
notes: Speaking to him before Najka unlocks his summon sign.

name: Vendrick — crown blessing

steps.location: Undead Crypt; Memory of the King
steps.action: Obtain the Ashen Mist Heart and use Vendrick’s discarded armor to enter the Memory of the King.

steps.location: Undead Crypt; Memory of the King
steps.action: Defeat Vendrick and acquire his crown, plus the crowns of the Sunken King, Old Iron King and Ivory King.

steps.location: Undead Crypt; Memory of the King
steps.action: Return to the memory with all four crowns and speak to Vendrick for the blessing.

reward: Blessed crowns prevent hollowing and curse while worn
notes: The blessing is for the current playthrough and must be earned again in NG+.
